body:
**Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.**

***User scenario:***

**My scenario:**
I have multiple workers listening on the same task queue for high throughput.
All the workers need to do some setup and cleanup work from time to time.
**My requirement:**
the business client can send a workflow or a command, which can be picked up and executed by all workers, instead of only one of them.
Is there any solution?

**Describe the solution you'd like**
My strawman proposal is to have a metadata map that is returned as part of every workflow or activity task. An admin API should support updating this map. The SDKs should watch for map changes and execute appropriate logic to notify workers about the changes.

comments.body:
I have a similar use case for this feature.

I am running a workflow that requires a large amount of data to be available and updated for workflows to run, so downloading this every run is undesirable. I could have each workflow check the centralized source of this, but that is also an API call per workflow, and most of the time there's no update.

Hello, I love your work btw.
---
My use case is because I want to use temporal as Control and Command Center in addition to its durable execution.

I would like to use temporal for also updating specific instances around the world, for that I need to shut down specific fleets or a subset of workers and start maintenance on each through their sidecar agent I've created. I've chosen not to have stateless containers and stick close to bare metal and precooked golden images and executables and that is why this very specific request I assume.

While I get that Temporal is a durable execution engine guaranteeing loadbalancing to "any" capable node and guarantee its execution - the possibility of a broadcast and multi-execution could, for me at least, open up for a variety of features.

Like running cleanup on all nodes. Manage or update state on a subset of nodes instead of managing an etcd cluster or similar.

title: Notify all workers on a task queue
